scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "pnpm --filter jobtrack-server dev" "pnpm --filter jobtrack-client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter jobtrack-client build && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server build
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server start
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter jobtrack-client lint && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter jobtrack-client lint:fix && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter jobtrack-client typecheck && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter jobtrack-client test && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter jobtrack-client test:coverage && pnpm --filter jobtrack-server test:coverage
